summary: Silexion Therapeutics Corp (SLXN) filed an 8-K regarding a warrant inducement transaction. On May 15, 2026, holders of 1,995,092 existing warrants (Series A, B, and Prior Inducement) agreed to exercise them for cash at a reduced price of $0.50/share, generating ~$1.0M gross proceeds. In exchange, Silexion issued New Warrants (Series C and D) to purchase up to 3,990,184 ordinary shares at $0.50/share. The company engaged H.C. Wainwright as placement agent with a 7.0% cash fee. The mechanics involve cash exercise and new warrant issuance, increasing potential dilution. Watch for the share price reaction and subsequent warrant exercises.
